description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Fetch and read the web] Pre-fetch gate for agents and scrapers: is this exact URL allowed by robots.txt (RFC 9309: missing = allow, 5xx/unreachable = disallow) for generic agents and 16 named AI agents/crawlers (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot...), plus Crawl-delay, Content-Signal (search / ai-input / ai-train), X-Robots-Tag noai/noindex from a HEAD request, and sitemaps. Verdict allowed / disallowed / allowed_but_no_ai_use / allowed_with_crawl_delay. Never downloads the page body. Cached up to 10 min. ~0.3-2 s.

trial.description: Optional. true = answer free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day); otherwise you get the payment terms.

url.description: Exact URL you plan to fetch, e.g. https://example.com/blog/post (a bare domain checks the home page)

name: can_fetch

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.
